name: Tenant Operations Copilot
scope: Hypothetical proposed feature for public contract analysis. This is not a claim that any named party has deployed, requested or authorized it.
user_goal: Choose the strongest useful design supported by the provided contract sets. Produce per-operation decisions, exact evidence, scoped precedence, unknowns, implementable gates and engineering work. Distinguish the customer running its own AI from the service provider using customer content for its own AI.
data: Customer technical documents and confidential information
Customer workload content and support logs

operations.actor: The contracting customer operates its own single-tenant model on the contracted platform or compute infrastructure.
operations.purpose: Answer that customer's own operational questions for its internal use.
operations.data_access: Only the customer's authorized users can read workload content. The service provider cannot read or interpret content and holds no customer decryption key.
operations.model: Customer-selected, open-weight model in a customer-controlled tenant. No separate model provider receives content.
operations.training: No provider training or cross-customer improvement.
operations.retention: Inference prompts are not retained by the service provider. Customer-controlled workload storage remains subject to the actual agreement.

operations.actor: The contracting service provider operates a tenant-isolated support copilot.
operations.purpose: Read customer workload content and confidential technical documents to answer support questions for that same customer.
operations.data_access: The service provider and its support model can read and interpret customer content. No other customer receives it.
operations.model: Service-provider-operated open-weight model. No separate external model provider receives content.
operations.training: Inference only. No model training or cross-customer improvement.
operations.retention: No retained prompts or output beyond the response session.

operations.actor: The contracting service provider trains its own model.
operations.purpose: Improve the provider's shared support model for use across its customer base.
operations.data_access: The service provider reads customer workload content, support logs and confidential technical information.
operations.model: Service-provider-owned shared model, trained and hosted in Australia. No separate external model provider receives content.
operations.training: Training on content from this customer. The shared model serves other customers.
operations.retention: Raw training examples retained for 30 days. Trained model retained indefinitely. No de-identification or consent is assumed.

c3-bhge.provider_role: C3.ai under the provided joint-venture documents
c3-bhge.customer_role: BHGE or the applicable downstream customer, as the documents require
c3-bhge.limits: Do not invent the separately referenced internal subscription MSSA, executed downstream MSSAs, orders, missing exhibits, redactions, renewals or later amendments. Assess the supplied public snapshot and identify what prevents a current decision.

sai-esds.customer_role: SPOCHUB SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED and ESDS Cloud FZ-LLC, subject to the exact MSA definitions and allocations
sai-esds.limits: Do not invent an executed Service Order, commissioning state, special conditions, permitted-territory election, end-customer permission or facts hidden by redaction. The proposal is not evidence that prerequisites are satisfied.
